title.en: 35 m³/h stays on the Electric Low Pressure 60 vs Diesel 60 page

description.en: Electric Low Pressure 60 vs Diesel 60. 35 m³/h stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Hydraulic machinery.
description.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60混凝土泵有何不同。35 m³/h仍在目录格子里。插图来自「液压机械」。

h1.en: 35 m³/h stays on the Electric Low Pressure 60 vs Diesel 60 page
h1.zh: 35 m³/h仍写在电动低压60和柴油60混凝土泵有何不同这一页

directAnswer.en: Electric Low Pressure 60 and Diesel 60 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Both list 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, a 0.4 m³ hopper is only on Diesel 60 while Low Pressure 60 lists 0.5 m³, and both list 3500 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery.
directAnswer.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。两边都标出 35 m³/h 和 30 MPa，重量都是 3500 kg。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery. The image subject is Hydraulic circuit directional control. Electric Low Pressure 60 and Diesel 60 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Model line: Electric Low Pressure 60 lists Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60. Diesel 60 lists Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery。画面内容是Hydraulic circuit directional control。电动低压60和柴油60是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。型号行：电动低压60标出 Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60；柴油60标出 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看电动低压60请打开 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/，看柴油60请打开 /zh/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Both list 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, a 0.4 m³ hopper is only on Diesel 60 while Low Pressure 60 lists 0.5 m³, and both list 3500 kg. Hopper capacity: Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 0.5 m³. Diesel 60 lists 0.4 m³. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Shared output and pressure still leave the power source and the distance layout different. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 两边都标出 35 m³/h 和 30 MPa，重量都是 3500 kg。料斗容积：电动低压60标出 0.5 m³；柴油60标出 0.4 m³。电动低压60有、柴油60没有的行：电机功率 75 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Low Pressure 60 lists 75 kW and three stone rows. Dimensions: Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Diesel 60 lists 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists entries that Diesel 60 does not: Motor power 75 kW. Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m. 13 mm stone (H / V) 100 m / 300 m. 24 mm stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m. Open /en/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/ for Electric Low Pressure 60 and /en/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 60.
body.zh: 料斗并不相同：柴油60为 0.4 m³，低压60为 0.5 m³。外形尺寸：电动低压60标出 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm；柴油60标出 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm。柴油60有、电动低压60没有的行：柴油机功率 6105 / 144 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Diesel 60 lists 6105 / 144 kW, model HBT60-13.132 and one distance pair, 150 m / 350 m. The same shown value on a shared label: Theoretical output is 35 m³/h on both pages. Max. outlet pressure is 30 MPa on both pages. Hydraulic pump is Kawasaki double pump 100 on both pages. Diesel 60 lists entries that Electric Low Pressure 60 does not: Diesel engine power 6105 / 144 kW. Pumping distance (H / V) 150 m / 350 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 柴油60标出 6105 / 144 kW、型号 HBT60-13.132，以及一组距离 150 m / 350 m。同一标题下数值相同的有：理论输送量两边都是 35 m³/h；最大出口压力两边都是 30 MPa；液压泵两边都是 Kawasaki double pump 100。产量和压力相同，动力来源和距离写法仍然不同。

question.en: Does Electric Low Pressure 60 list the same model line as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60的型号行一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60. Diesel 60 lists Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动低压60标出 Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60。柴油60标出 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric Low Pressure 60 list the same hopper capacity as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60的料斗容积一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 0.5 m³. Diesel 60 lists 0.4 m³. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动低压60标出 0.5 m³。柴油60标出 0.4 m³。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric Low Pressure 60 list the same dimensions as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 电动低压60和柴油60的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Diesel 60 lists 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动低压60标出 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm。柴油60标出 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is motor power missing on Diesel 60?
question.zh: 为什么柴油60没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Diesel 60 page does not list that label. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 75 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery.
answer.zh: 柴油60这一页没有标出这个标题。电动低压60标出的是 75 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_machinery画面里印出的数字。
